rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for commercial business or trade in general.

example.english: Commerce is thriving at this shop.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou2 tau4 saang1 ji3 hou2 hou2

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the activity of buying and selling goods rather than the business as a whole.

example.english: Commerce here has been very quiet lately.
example.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ni1 dou6 ge3 maai5 maai6 hou2 daam6

rows.note: Use this for organized or large-scale trade, especially trade between countries or regions.

example.english: Commerce between Hong Kong and ASEAN has been growing steadily.
example.traditional: 香港同東盟嘅貿易一直增加。
example.jyutping: hoeng1 gong2 tung4 dung1 mang4 ge3 mau6 jik6 jat1 zik6 zang1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for commerce as a broad commercial sector or economic activity, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: Commerce is very important to Hong Kong's economy.
example.traditional: 商業對香港經濟好重要。
example.jyutping: soeng1 jip6 deoi3 hoeng1 gong2 ging1 zai3 hou2 zung6 jiu3
